Common failures at this stage in past runs:
- Matters that surfaced in the agent's own searches, scans or candidate lists were left out of the reading shortlist, never opened, and so dropped from or misclassified in the answer from snippets alone.
- A matter's needed proof document (executed agreement, closing or covenant memo, complaint or motion, spreadsheet) appeared in a listing, but the agent opened or cited other documents of that matter or a sibling matter instead.
- A matter's proof document never appeared in any search or listing because the agent never listed that matter's folder, so it read peripheral papers and cited no proof record.
Common failures at 'Scan document text with an extraction script':
- After a scan that reached every qualifying matter, a follow-up filter on file names, document types, exact phrases or execution flags, or a cap on printed lines, dropped matters, and the candidate set was built only from the filtered or visible output.
- The scan itself missed matters because it was prefiltered by file name or file type, timed out, had a range filter that failed, or was read only partially, and the partial output was treated as the whole store without a rerun or a broader search.
- Scan hits listed matters that qualified, but the agent read only a hand-picked or number-ranked subset and never opened the rest.
- The script printed snippets for common terms across every matter with no output cap, so the output filled the context and no answer could be written.
What successful runs did: Passing runs picked reads directly from the scan hits and listings, covering every matter with specific hits, and opened the key document (executed agreement, closing memo, complaint, status report) in each rather than peripheral papers.
Reconsider before moving on. If the goal was not fully reached, or any failure above applies, reopen this stage now: call stage_start with stage="Screen candidate matters by reading documents" and a goal that says what you will fix. Otherwise call stage_start for the next stage you need.
